description: Opt-in automerge preset for Hartorn-Inc repositories whose full CI test suite and zizmor Gate are required status checks. Extend after github>Hartorn-Inc/.github.

packageRules.description: Group and automerge non-major (minor, patch) updates for npm, pep621, and cargo behind required CI tests.
Group and automerge non-major GitHub Actions uses: updates (action and workflow refs); digest-only tag moves and majors stay manual.
Pin digests for Docker Hub images in Dockerfiles and Compose files.
Group and automerge non-major Docker Hub Dockerfile updates (minor, patch, and digest refreshes); non-Docker-Hub registries and majors stay manual.
Group and automerge non-major Docker Hub Compose updates (minor, patch, and digest refreshes); non-Docker-Hub registries and majors stay manual.
Keep Ubuntu release upgrades (minor/major) manual so only same-release digest refreshes join dockerfile-deps-non-major.
Require manual review for major updates across all managers.
